Name: Call It Cave Root
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Hello all! Beast here.This is my first ever mod upload. I hope it will be of interest to some people![/i]

[b]What It Does:[/b]
[list]
[*]Simply changes the name of the item Cave Carrot to "Cave Root" instead.
[/list][i][size=2]I've tried to locate and alter all mentions of "Cave Carrot" in-game aside from the item itself, but if I missed anything, I'd really appreciate a heads-up![/size][/i]

[b]Why?:[/b]
[list]
[*]I wanted there to be more distinction between this item and actual carrots.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Only works in English currently.
[/list]
[b]Possible Conflicts:[/b]
[list]
[*]Anything that edits the item "Cave Carrot" or the related events/quests.
[/list][i]Please let me know if you find any![/i]

[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Downloads.Description: Renames Cave Carrot to Cave Root.
